sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, secured another victory on Saturday with a 2-0 win over Eccleshall at home. The Ramblers' next fixture sees them travel away to face Widnes Town at Trentham Foods Stadium, where they will look to extend their impressive form—though Widnes sit bottom of the league with just 2 points from 7 games.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town earned a dramatic 3-3 draw against Cheadle Heath Nomads after going down to 10 men early in the second half, with Mazurkiewicz levelling in the 83rd minute to maintain their unbeaten run. In other notable results, Allscott Heath produced a dominant 4-1 away performance at Alsager Town, Bilston Town thrashed Market Drayton 3-0 (with Drayton reduced to 10 men), Barnton won 2-0 away at struggling Telford Town, Wednesfield Community secured their first clean sheet of the season in a 1-0 away victory at Crewe, and Wolverhampton Casuals powered past Shawbury United 3-1 away. In tight matches, Brereton Social edged AFC Bridgnorth 1-0 at home with an own goal, while Dawley Town claimed an impressive 2-1 away win at New Mills. Eccleshall's loss to Sandbach halted their recent form, having won four in a row prior to the match.
